evidence.ACL: Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.
evidence.MCL: The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Extensive multilobulated parameniscal cyst adjacent to the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus, measuring up to 42 x 5 x 19 mm in maximum aggregate dimensions. This raises suspicion for underlying horizontal cleavage tear extending through the anterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: Scattered foci of mild chondrosis throughout the medial and lateral femorotibial compartments.
evidence.Lateral OA: Scattered foci of mild chondrosis throughout the medial and lateral femorotibial compartments.
evidence.PF OA: Mild to moderate chondrosis most pronounced involving the patellofemoral compartment, suggesting evolving mild patellofemoral predominant osteoarthritis of the right knee.
evidence.Contusion: No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.
evidence.Fracture: No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.
